states.web: idle: the body breathes (orb-breathe) and the reflections turn slowly on ds-spin. listening: a faster breath and a ring rippling out (orb-ripple). thinking: the body is still and the reflections spin fast, the agent-tinted one fully visible. speaking: the body pulses unevenly (orb-speak). asleep: dimmed (brightness and saturation down) and barely turning. Under reduced motion the listening ring stays as a still ring, speaking stays slightly enlarged and asleep stays dimmed.
